feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. The candidate is valid. It changes one field from the iteration 2 design: controller.kp 2.0 to 2.5, with sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kd 0.3, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2] and last_direction unchanged. That isolates the steering-gain question that iteration 2 left open. Iteration 2 (score 115.4) ended every run off_track. Max_error was 0.062 on the oval and 0.062 on the s-bend, against the 0.06 m limit, and line_loss_events were still 1.2, 1.15 and 1.0. The footprint is already at its maximum, so line loss can only be reduced by steering authority or the line_loss rule. The oval produced one finish at 1.97 s, so base_speed 1.3 is not too slow for that track. Steering_oscillation was 0.14 to 0.23, which is low, so kd 0.3 leaves room to raise kp. The best raced score is still iteration 1 (128.9). Judge this candidate against that figure once it races. Next revision, depending on the race: (a) if max_error stays at or above about 0.06 m on the s-bend or slalom while steering_oscillation rises sharply, do not raise kp further; go back toward kp 2.0 and test the line_loss rule instead. (b) If max_error falls below about 0.058 m and line_loss_events drop to 1 or less, but completion_time is above 3 s, raise base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5 with kp 2.5 held. (c) If max_error still reaches 0.06 m with steering_oscillation low, try kp 3.0 as the only change. (d) If line_loss_events stay at 1 or more per run with kp 2.5, change controller.line_loss to search_right as the only change, since the footprint is already maxed.
requested_changes: If max_error still reaches about 0.06 m on the s-bend or slalom and steering_oscillation stays low (iteration 2 showed 0.14 to 0.23): raise controller.kp from 2.5 to 3.0, keeping geometry.sensor_size 0.016, kd 0.3 and base_speed 1.3.

If max_error falls below about 0.058 m but completion_time exceeds 3 s (the oval finish at 1.97 s in iteration 2 suggests speed is adequate there, so check the s-bend and slalom): raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5, keeping kp 2.5.

If line_loss_events remain at 1 or more per run with kp 2.5 (iteration 2 showed 1.0 to 1.2 at kp 2.0): change controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right as the only change, since sensor_size is already at its maximum 0.016.
